description: Show how one Chinese character connects to others. Returns the components it is built from, characters that contain it, characters that look similar and are easy to confuse with it, the other characters that share its sound component, and common words that start with or contain it. Use this when the user wants to learn a character through its parts, tell look-alike characters apart, or see a character family. Do not use it for words of two or more characters.

character.description: Exactly one Chinese character, for example 请.

name: get_related_characters
title: Find related Chinese characters
